_comment: GDD 7.9 and 12. use: where it can be used (battle, field, both, key = never consumed by use). effect values are fractions of max HP or Focus points. price 0 = not sold.

Math Capsule.description: Captures a weakened wild monster after a binding challenge.

Revival Crystal.description: Revives a fainted monster with 30% HP.

Evolution Crystal.description: Awakens the Evolution Shrine. Not used up.

Stone Charm.description: Bram's thanks. GEOMAX and GEOMAXIMUS take 10% less damage while you carry it.

Crystal Shard.description: A shard from the Crystal Seal. Sell it at the shop.
